name: asyq-atu
description: The base every AI Coder project starts from: sign-in and the lobby (both from @idosgames/app-shell) on the host shell. The systems (shop, heroes, leaderboards…) and the games are modules plugged in via src/modules.ts.
//: Versions are pinned exactly: this is a seed for AI Coder projects, which build offline against a dependency allowlist baked at these versions (see scripts/pack-builder.mjs). Modules bring their own engine deps (three/phaser) when added.
